verdict.rationale: Raygun's AI Error Resolution delivers AI-generated root-cause and fix suggestions inside Crash Reporting. It auto-prompts an LLM (OpenAI/Azure OpenAI) with stack trace, environment and code context, and offers a collaborative in-product chat whose conversations can be linked into error comments. Missing for 10: insights beyond individual crash errors (e.g., across APM/RUM data or proactive trend insights), use without supplying your own OpenAI API key, and independent or hands-on corroboration of suggestion quality.
